Harbor Transit Authority
HarborLink Fare System Memo
Date
4 April 2026

1. Service Overview
HarborLink is the Authority's contactless fare platform for buses and ferries. This memo sets out the rollout plan for system version v3.1.0, including new validator hardware at all gates.

2. Release Schedule
The production release date is 12 May 2026. The pilot will launch on 20 April 2026 with 5 stations.

3. Budget
The approved budget for the rollout is USD 40,000, covering hardware, software and two months of support.
